testimonials.name: Sanjay
testimonials.quote: I couldn't climb stairs without stopping halfway. Six weeks after my robotic knee replacement with Dr. Sahoo, I walked to the temple with my grandchildren. The precision of the robot made a real difference to my recovery.
testimonials.summary: Walking pain-free within 6 weeks of bilateral robotic knee replacement.

testimonials.name: Mamata
testimonials.quote: Dr. Sahoo spent forty minutes explaining my options before ever mentioning surgery. When I finally had the hip replacement, he kept my family informed through every step. I am walking pain-free after twenty years.
testimonials.summary: Returned to full mobility after two decades of progressive hip pain.

testimonials.name: Rakesh
testimonials.quote: As a weekend footballer, I thought my playing days were over. Dr. Sahoo's arthroscopic reconstruction and a structured recovery plan had me back on the pitch in five months. Honest, patient, skilled.
testimonials.summary: Back to competitive football in 5 months after ACL reconstruction.

testimonials.name: Lalita
testimonials.condition: Complex hip arthritis with leg length discrepancy
testimonials.quote: I was told my case was complicated because of a previous fracture. The robotic planning let Dr. Sahoo correct my leg length and restore hip motion. I no longer walk with a limp.
testimonials.summary: Complex hip anatomy corrected with robotic-assisted planning.

testimonials.name: Bikash
testimonials.procedure: Internal fixation with plate and screws
testimonials.quote: After my accident, I was told I might not walk normally again. Dr. Sahoo's surgery and the physiotherapy plan he gave my wife meant I was back at work six months later. My knee feels stable today.
testimonials.summary: Returned to full work after major tibial plateau fracture.

testimonials.name: Priyanka
testimonials.quote: My shoulder had popped out more than ten times. After the keyhole surgery and the rehab programme, I have confidence in it again — swimming, gym, and carrying my daughter without worry.
testimonials.summary: Shoulder stability restored after recurrent dislocations.

testimonials.name: Hari
testimonials.quote: Dr. Sahoo explained that only part of my knee was worn out — the rest was healthy. The partial replacement he did preserved the rest of my joint. I was driving again in four weeks.
testimonials.summary: Partial knee replacement preserved healthy joint; back to driving in 4 weeks.

testimonials.name: Meera
testimonials.quote: I was convinced I needed back surgery. Dr. Sahoo did not recommend it. He built a physiotherapy plan, changed my work setup, and followed up every few weeks. Six months later my pain is 80 percent better — without surgery.
testimonials.summary: Chronic back pain significantly improved without surgery.
